notablePrerequisites:
Presence of Gond attached to Scuttling Sliver.
Scuttling Sliver does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Scuttling Sliver by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Elf Warrior creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Elf Warrior, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Scuttling Sliver by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.
